fact: Madagascar Customs says Sydonia++ is its automated customs system, installed centrally, and that TradeNet electronically registers declarations and is operational at 11 offices, near-total coverage of clearance operations.
Madagascar Customs says paperless clearance, using a Midac web application alongside Sydonia, is under test at the Mamory Ivato office.

Madagascar Customs says TradeNet interconnects declarants, customs, banks and the ministries and control agencies that issue permits and licences for clearance, reinforcing the existing single window.

Ministerial arrete 36657/2015 requires all clearance exchanges at computerised customs offices to be transmitted electronically through the customs system, comprising SYDONIA and the TradeNet platform.

The Customs Code (art. 87, as amended by the 2023 finance law) requires declarations at customs offices equipped with computer systems to be lodged electronically, and art. 88 refers to an automated clearance system.
